'''2009 Dantooine Regionals Joseph Graham LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joseph Graham]] at [[2009 Dantooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' HB
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
